final_decision.rationale: Pair0 (primary): no compression (block_boundary=0.9996, unique_G=233; confirmed on p1=1.009, p2=0.997). Global is saturate_strengthen_HSV, NOT brightness_darken: chroma_ratio +66%/+150%/+66% and spread halved cannot be produced by any brightness function (peel with brightness left residual_std 51.4 vs 10.2 for saturation); only one global step is possible. Blur is strong and isotropic: FFT anisotropy 1.15 (motion excluded), glass peel worse; gaussian sev3 is the only severity whose spectral_slope and Wiener kernel pass on all 3 pairs (sev4/5 fail slope 0.238/0.405; lens fails sigma 350%). Noise precedes blur: post-blur RGB noise fails variance (+40%) and sigma (2800%), sat-before-blur fails variance (1005%), while noise->blur reproduces target variance_ratio and spectral slope on every pair. Under this order SKILL rates noise-type accuracy 54.7% (~random), so the noise function/severity is UNCERTAIN; noise_speckle:3 is the best empirical fit (5/6 checks on pair0 including mean_shift and variance_ratio; variance_ratio 1.351 vs target 1.371, pair1 0.9664 vs 0.9667, pair2 0.9626 vs 0.9823), with gaussian_YCrCb:2/:4 and poisson:3 kept as cross-family alternatives. Residual uncertainty: simulated saturation over-darkens pairs 1/2 by ~5 gray levels (mean_shift diff 0.0195/0.0209) with ~5% more clipping, consistent with severity slightly above truth or content-dependent S-clamp interaction.

final_decision.rationale: Blur_gaussian:3 is the peak of the PSNR bracket over severities {2,3,4,5} on all 3 pairs; compression is absent on all 3 pairs; saturation stays HSV (brightness peel leaves residual_std 51.4 vs 10.2). The R1 changes are (a) saturation severity 4 -> 3, driven by R0's own over-darkening/over-clipping observation plus the untested lower bracket, and (b) removal of the noise step, driven by the structured peeled residual (spatial_corr ~0.987), inconsistent per-pair sigma (3.83/1.11/0.49; pairs1/2 below the sigma<2 NO_NOISE threshold), the 54.7% ~random noise-type reliability under noise->blur, and the mis-scaled injected-noise RMS.
